# PART 1: MASTER OVERVIEW & VISION

## 1.1 Vision Statement

ConsciousOS Content Library is the world's most interconnected personal consciousness exploration library. It combines:

- **Netflix** — discover content (browse, search, recommendations)
- **Spotify** — discover audio and podcasts (audio experiences, playlists)
- **Duolingo** — interactive learning and games (gamified awareness)
- **MasterClass** — structured programs (multi-day transformation journeys)
- **Wikipedia** — interconnected wisdom and knowledge (knowledge graph)
- **RPG games** — quests, challenges, progression (XP, levels, achievements)
- **Yogic university** — practices, teachings, transformation (authentic yogic science)

**Objective:** Every user should have thousands of meaningful things to explore, learn, experience, and practice.

# PART 2: CONTENT TYPE TEMPLATES

## 2.1 Universal LibraryItem Schema

Every content item MUST conform to this TypeScript interface:

```typescript
interface LibraryItem {
  id: string;                          // Format: {type}-{5-digit-index}, e.g. "practice-00042"
  title: string;                       // Max 80 chars, descriptive, unique
  description: string;                 // 50-200 chars, explains what it is
  short_description?: string;          // 20-60 chars for cards

  type: LibraryItemType;               // One of 30 types
  category: string;                    // Main category slug
  subcategory: string;                 // Subcategory slug

  duration_minutes?: number;           // 1-120, null for non-timed
  difficulty: 'beginner' | 'intermediate' | 'advanced' | 'all';

  consciousness_dimensions: string[];   // 1-4 from: thought, emotion, body, action, connection, spirit
  life_domains: string[];              // 1-4 from 14 domains
  yoga_paths: string[];                // 1-3 from: raja, bhakti, jnana, karma, kriya, tantra, hatha

  suitable_bands: string[];            // From: "0-2", "3-5", "6-8", "9-10", "all"
  suitable_profiles: string[];         // From: "fast", "steady", "deep"
  prerequisites: string[];             // Array of item IDs

  tags: string[];                      // 5-12 tags from tag taxonomy
  related_items: string[];             // 3-10 item IDs (knowledge graph edges)

  content: Record<string, unknown>;    // Type-specific payload (see templates below)

  source: 'original' | 'licensed' | 'public_domain' | 'curated' | 'ai_generated_reviewed';
  provenance?: string;                 // Original source/citation
  quality_score?: number;              // 0.0-1.0
  review_status: 'draft' | 'review' | 'published';

  version: number;                     // Start at 1
  created_at: string;                  // ISO timestamp
  updated_at: string;                  // ISO timestamp
  published_at?: string;               // ISO timestamp when published

  cover_image_url?: string;
  audio_url?: string;
  video_url?: string;

  popularity_score?: number;           // 0.0-1.0
  completion_count?: number;
  average_rating?: number;             // 0.0-5.0
}
```

## 2.2 Consciousness Dimensions

| ID | Label | Description |
|----|-------|-------------|
| thought | Thought (Mind) | Clarity of thinking, cognitive patterns, belief structures |
| emotion | Emotion (Heart) | Emotional intelligence, regulation, depth of feeling |
| body | Body (Gut/Instinct) | Somatic awareness, energy sensitivity, physical intuition |
| action | Action (Karma) | Integrity of action, alignment between values and behavior |
| connection | Connection (Relational) | Depth of relationships, empathy, community awareness |
| spirit | Spirit (Awareness) | Pure awareness, witness consciousness, non-dual perception |

**Rules:**
- Every item must have at least 1 dimension, max 4
- Practices should target 2-3 dimensions
- Wisdom items: 1-2 dimensions
- Games: 2-3 dimensions
- Programs: 3-4 dimensions (holistic)

## 3.1 Practice Template

```typescript
{
  type: "practice",
  content: {
    objective: string,              // 1 sentence: what this practice develops
    instructions: string[],          // 4-8 step-by-step instructions
    session_steps: [                 // 3-6 steps with timing
      {
        order: number,
        type: "instruction" | "practice" | "reflection" | "meditation",
        title: string,
        content: string,
        duration_seconds: number,
        widget_id?: string           // Optional interactive widget
      }
    ],
    required_widgets: string[],       // Widget IDs needed
    expected_experience: string,      // What user might feel/experience
    contraindications: string[],      // Who should NOT do this
    safety_notes: string,            // Safety information
    tips?: string[],                 // Optional tips for success
    variations?: string[],            // Optional variations
    audio_guide_url?: string,        // Optional audio guide
    video_guide_url?: string         // Optional video guide
  }
}
```

## 3.4 Game Template

```typescript
{
  type: "game",
  content: {
    game_type: string,              // Category of game
    mechanics: {
      rounds?: number,
      timer_seconds?: number,
      difficulty_levels?: string[],
      multiplayer?: boolean,
      // ... game-specific mechanics
    },
    scoring_rules: {
      points_per_action?: number,
      bonus_conditions?: string[],
      max_score?: number
    },
    observation_outputs: string[],   // What meaningful observations this generates
    estimated_minutes: number,
    replayable: boolean,
    levels?: {                      // Optional level progression
      level: number,
      name: string,
      unlock_criteria: string
    }[],
    achievements?: {                // Optional achievements
      id: string,
      name: string,
      description: string
    }[]
  }
}
```

- Games should have replayability
- Include observation_outputs array listing what insights are generated
- Games should be completable in 1-10 minutes
- Include difficulty progression

# PART 5: KNOWLEDGE GRAPH CONNECTION RULES

## 5.1 Connection Requirements

Every library item MUST have at least 3 `related_items` connections. Target connections per item:

| Item Type | Min Related Items | Target Connections |
|-----------|------------------|-------------------|
| Practice | 3 | 5-8 |
| Wisdom | 3 | 5-10 |
| Game | 3 | 4-6 |
| Program | 5 | 8-15 |
| Meditation | 3 | 4-6 |
| Podcast | 2 | 3-5 |
| Story | 3 | 4-6 |
| Assessment | 3 | 5-8 |

## 5.2 Connection Types (RelationshipType)

| Type | Description | Example |
|------|-------------|---------|
| related_to | General relation | Practice ↔ Wisdom on same topic |
| prerequisite_of | Must complete first | Basic breathwork → Advanced pranayama |
| part_of_program | Belongs to program | Practice → Program day |
| part_of_course | Belongs to course | Lesson → Course module |
| teaches_concept | Teaches a concept | Wisdom → Practice application |
| dissolves_loop | Helps dissolve a pattern | Practice → Psychological loop |
| develops_skill | Develops a skill | Practice → Skill node |
| references_wisdom | References wisdom | Practice → Wisdom teaching |
| pairs_with | Works well together | Two complementary practices |
| alternative_to | Alternative approach | Two different meditation styles |
| deepens | Goes deeper | Basic → Advanced version |
| simplifies | Simpler version | Advanced → Beginner version |
| follows | Sequential | Step 1 → Step 2 |
| precedes | Comes before | Step 2 ← Step 1 |

## 5.3 Auto-Connection Rules

When generating content, automatically connect items that share:

1. **Same consciousness dimension** → related_to (weight 0.6)
2. **Same subcategory** → related_to (weight 0.8)
3. **Same yoga path** → pairs_with (weight 0.5)
4. **Same life domain** → related_to (weight 0.4)
5. **Prerequisite chain** → prerequisite_of (weight 1.0)
6. **Program membership** → part_of_program (weight 1.0)
7. **Concept reference** → references_wisdom (weight 0.7)

## 5.4 Cross-Category Connection Matrix

A single concept should connect to:

- 10 practices
- 5 wisdom teachings
- 3 games
- 2 programs
- 5 podcasts
- 10 reflection questions
- 3 challenges

**Example: "Witness Consciousness" concept connects to:**
- 10 practices: Witness the Breath, Body Scan, Self-Inquiry, Trataka, etc.
- 5 wisdom: Sakshi teaching, Advaita Vedanta, Yoga Sutras 1.3, etc.
- 3 games: Find the Observer, Silent Witness, Who Is Thinking?
- 2 programs: Become the Witness (21 days), Deep Self-Inquiry (40 days)
- 5 podcasts: Guided witness meditation, Yogic wisdom on sakshi, etc.
- 10 reflection questions: "Who is aware?", "What is the witness?", etc.
- 3 challenges: 7-day witness challenge, 30-day observation challenge, etc.

## 5.5 Graph Traversal for Recommendations

When recommending content, use graph proximity:
- Items 1 hop away from user's completed items: boost 0.3
- Items 2 hops away: boost 0.15
- Items sharing dimensions with weak areas: boost 0.25
- Items in same program as current: boost 0.4

# PART 6: QUALITY STANDARDS & VALIDATION

## 6.1 Minimum Quality Criteria

Every item must pass ALL of these:

1. **Required fields present:** title, description, type, category, subcategory, difficulty, consciousness_dimensions, tags, source, review_status
2. **Title:** 3-80 characters, unique, descriptive
3. **Description:** 50-200 characters
4. **Tags:** 5-12 tags from approved taxonomy
5. **Consciousness dimensions:** 1-4 from approved list
6. **Related items:** 3+ connections
7. **Quality score:** >= 0.7
8. **No duplicate titles** within same category

## 6.2 Type-Specific Quality

### Practices
- Instructions: 4-8 steps, clear and actionable
- Session steps: 3-6 steps with timing
- Expected experience: described
- Contraindications: listed (can be empty for safe practices)
- Safety notes: present

### Wisdom
- Concept: clearly named
- Explanation: 100-300 words
- Practical application: present
- Reflection questions: 3-5
- References: 1+ citations
- Traditional vs modern clearly distinguished

### Games
- Game type: specified
- Mechanics: defined
- Scoring rules: present
- Observation outputs: 2+ listed
- Estimated minutes: 1-10

### Programs
- Duration: 7-90 days
- Daily time: 5-30 minutes
- Days array: complete for duration
- Each day has practices, wisdom, reflection, mission
- Completion criteria: defined

### Assessments
- Questions: 5-20
- Scoring logic: defined
- Result types: 3-8
- Each question has options with weights

## 6.3 Quality Scoring Formula

```
quality_score = (
  required_fields_present / total_required * 0.4 +
  recommended_fields_present / total_recommended * 0.2 +
  type_specific_fields_present / total_type_specific * 0.2 +
  content_richness_score * 0.1 +
  source_quality_score * 0.1
)
```

Where:
- content_richness_score = 1.0 if related_items >= 3 AND tags >= 5, else 0.5
- source_quality_score = 1.0 if source != 'ai_generated_reviewed' AND provenance present, else 0.5

**Minimum acceptable: 0.7**

## 6.4 Validation Pipeline

```typescript
function validateItem(item: LibraryItem): { valid: boolean; errors: string[] } {
  const errors: string[] = [];
  
  // Required fields
  if (!item.title || item.title.length < 3) errors.push('Title too short');
  if (!item.description || item.description.length < 50) errors.push('Description too short');
  if (!item.type) errors.push('Missing type');
  if (!item.category) errors.push('Missing category');
  if (!item.subcategory) errors.push('Missing subcategory');
  if (!item.difficulty) errors.push('Missing difficulty');
  if (!item.consciousness_dimensions || item.consciousness_dimensions.length === 0) errors.push('Missing dimensions');
  if (!item.tags || item.tags.length < 5) errors.push('Need 5+ tags');
  if (!item.related_items || item.related_items.length < 3) errors.push('Need 3+ related items');
  if (!item.source) errors.push('Missing source');
  
  // Type-specific
  if (item.type === 'practice') {
    const c = item.content as any;
    if (!c.instructions || c.instructions.length < 4) errors.push('Practice needs 4+ instructions');
    if (!c.session_steps || c.session_steps.length < 3) errors.push('Practice needs 3+ session steps');
  }
  
  if (item.type === 'wisdom') {
    const c = item.content as any;
    if (!c.concept) errors.push('Wisdom needs concept');
    if (!c.explanation || c.explanation.length < 100) errors.push('Wisdom explanation too short');
    if (!c.practical_application) errors.push('Wisdom needs practical application');
    if (!c.reflection_questions || c.reflection_questions.length < 3) errors.push('Wisdom needs 3+ reflection questions');
  }
  
  return { valid: errors.length === 0, errors };
}
```

# PART 7: BATCH GENERATION PROTOCOL

## 7.1 Generation Order (Priority)

**Phase 1 (P0 - Core):**
1. Yogic Practices (1,800)
2. Micro Practices (1,200)
3. Wisdom & Teachings (1,200)
4. Guided Programs (700)

**Phase 2 (P1 - High Value):**
5. Games (600)
6. Podcasts (600)
7. Meditations (500)
8. Journaling (500)
9. Self-Inquiry (450)
10. Breathwork (350)
11. Somatic (350)

**Phase 3 (P2 - Expansion):**
12. Challenges (400)
13. Rituals (400)
14. Courses (300)
15. Stories (300)
16. Daily Missions (300)
17. Tools (250)
18. Assessments (150)

**Phase 4 (Additional Libraries):**
19-32. Additional libraries (3,558)

## 7.2 Batch Size & Process

- **Batch size:** 50-100 items per generation call
- **Validation:** Run validateItem() on every item
- **Quality check:** Score >= 0.7
- **Dedup check:** No duplicate titles within category
- **Relationship check:** 3+ related_items per item
- **Status:** Start as 'draft', move to 'review', then 'published'

## 7.3 Generation Workflow

```
For each category:
  1. Read the template for that content type
  2. Read the subcategory breakdown
  3. For each subcategory:
     a. Generate batch of 50-100 items
     b. Validate each item
     c. Score quality (>= 0.7)
     d. Check for duplicates
     e. Assign related_items connections
     f. Save as draft
  4. Review batch
  5. Publish approved items
  6. Update category counts
```

## 7.4 ID Generation

Format: `{type_slug}-{5-digit-index}`
- practice-00001, practice-00002, ..., practice-01800
- micro_practice-00001, ..., micro_practice-01200

# PART 9: RELATIONSHIP MAPPING MATRIX

## 9.1 Automatic Relationship Rules

When generating content, apply these rules automatically:

### Rule 1: Dimension Overlap
If two items share 2+ consciousness dimensions → `related_to` (weight: 0.6)

### Rule 2: Subcategory Siblings
If two items are in the same subcategory → `related_to` (weight: 0.8)

### Rule 3: Yoga Path Alignment
If two items share a yoga path → `pairs_with` (weight: 0.5)

### Rule 4: Life Domain Overlap
If two items share 2+ life domains → `related_to` (weight: 0.4)

### Rule 5: Prerequisite Chains
If item B requires item A → `prerequisite_of` (weight: 1.0)

### Rule 6: Program Membership
If item is part of a program → `part_of_program` (weight: 1.0)

### Rule 7: Concept Reference
If practice references wisdom → `references_wisdom` (weight: 0.7)

### Rule 8: Difficulty Progression
If item B is advanced version of A → `deepens` (weight: 0.9)

### Rule 9: Simplified Version
If item B is beginner version of A → `simplifies` (weight: 0.9)

### Rule 10: Alternative Approach
If two items achieve same goal differently → `alternative_to` (weight: 0.7)

# PART 10: DISCOVERY & RECOMMENDATION RULES

## 10.1 Discovery Sections

The Explore page must show these sections:

1. **Continue Your Journey** — User's ongoing program + recent items
2. **Explore Worlds** — 18 category cards with counts
3. **For Your Current State** — 4 personalized recommendations
4. **Popular This Week** — Top 6 by popularity_score
5. **Recently Added** — Top 6 by created_at
6. **Deep Exploration** — 6 advanced items
7. **Random Discovery** — 6 random items

## 10.2 Recommendation Scoring

```typescript
score = (
  dimensionAlignment * 0.25 +    // Weak dimensions match
  durationFit * 0.15 +           // Fits available time
  timeOfDayFit * 0.15 +          // Matches time of day
  bandSuitability * 0.10 +       // Appropriate for user's band
  novelty * 0.10 +               // Not recently completed
  popularity * 0.05 +            // Popular items
  favoriteBoost * 0.10 +         // User favorites
  graphProximity * 0.10          // Near completed items
)
```

## 10.3 Time-of-Day Profiles

| Time | Preferred Tags | Avoid Tags | Max Duration |
|------|---------------|------------|--------------|
| Morning (5-12) | morning, energy, activation, focus, clarity | sleep, evening, deep_rest | 30 min |
| Afternoon (12-17) | focus, reset, energy, productivity | | 20 min |
| Evening (17-21) | evening, calm, reflection, wind_down, gratitude | activation, energy, intense | 15 min |
| Night (21-5) | sleep, calm, body_scan, breath, stillness, surrender | activation, energy, focus, intense | 10 min |

## 10.4 Daily Bundle

Every day, generate a bundle of 4 items:
1. One 5-minute awareness game
2. One 8-minute body-awareness practice
3. One relevant wisdom teaching
4. One 3-minute reflection

## 10.5 Diversity Enforcement

- Max 2 items per category in any recommendation set
- No duplicate items in a single recommendation set
- Rotate categories across days

# PART 11: CONTENT VERSIONING & PROVENANCE

## 11.1 Versioning

- All items start at version 1
- Increment version on any content change
- Store previous versions in content_versions table
- Track changed_by and change_notes

## 11.2 Provenance Requirements

| Source Type | Provenance Required | Format |
|-------------|-------------------|--------|
| original | Description of origin | "ConsciousOS original practice" |
| licensed | License + creator | "Licensed from [Creator], [License]" |
| public_domain | Source text | "Public domain, [Source text]" |
| curated | Source + curation note | "Curated from [Source], adapted for ConsciousOS" |
| ai_generated_reviewed | AI model + reviewer | "AI-generated, reviewed by [Reviewer]" |

## 11.3 Quality Tracking

- Track quality_score on every item
- Re-score after any update
- Items below 0.7 should be flagged for review
- Published items should have score >= 0.8

# PART 12: SAFETY & CONTRAINDICATION STANDARDS

## 12.1 Contraindication Categories

| Category | Examples | Required For |
|----------|----------|--------------|
| Physical | Acute pain, recent surgery, pregnancy | Body practices, breathwork, movement |
| Psychological | Severe anxiety, psychosis, trauma | Deep inquiry, shadow work, intense breathwork |
| Medical | Heart conditions, epilepsy, hypertension | Intense breathwork, inverted postures |
| General | None (safe for all) | Gentle practices, wisdom, stories |

## 12.2 Safety Notes Requirements

Every practice, breathwork, and somatic item MUST include:
- `contraindications`: Array of conditions (can be empty)
- `safety_notes`: String with safety information

## 12.3 Trauma-Informed Guidelines

For trauma-sensitive content:
- Use invitational language ("you might", "if comfortable")
- Always offer modifications
- Include grounding techniques
- Never force or push
- Allow choice at every step
- Include "stop if uncomfortable" guidance

---

# PART 13: LOCALIZATION & I18N

## 13.1 Supported Languages (Initial)

- English (en) — primary
- Hindi (hi) — secondary
- Sanskrit (sa) — for mantras/terms

## 13.2 Localization Rules

- Title and description must be localizable
- Instructions should be clear in all languages
- Sanskrit terms should include transliteration
- Mantras should include meaning
- Wisdom excerpts should include original + translation

---

# PART 14: MEDIA & ASSET GUIDELINES

## 14.1 Image Guidelines

- Cover images: 16:9 aspect ratio, min 800×450px
- Thumbnails: 1:1 aspect ratio, min 400×400px
- Format: WebP preferred, JPEG fallback
- Style: Calm, minimal, nature-inspired

## 14.2 Audio Guidelines

- Format: MP3 (128kbps) or AAC
- Background music: Optional, subtle
- Voice: Clear, calm, measured pace
- Duration: Match content duration + 10% buffer

## 14.3 Video Guidelines

- Format: MP4 (H.264)
- Resolution: 720p minimum
- Duration: Match content duration
- Style: Minimal, instructional

---

# PART 15: ADMIN & REVIEW WORKFLOW

## 15.1 Content Lifecycle

```
draft → review → published → archived
```

- **draft:** Initial creation, not visible to users
- **review:** Submitted for review, quality check
- **published:** Approved, visible to users
- **archived:** No longer active, hidden from discovery

## 15.2 Review Checklist

Before publishing, verify:
- [ ] All required fields present
- [ ] Quality score >= 0.7
- [ ] No duplicate title in category
- [ ] 3+ related_items connections
- [ ] Safety notes present (for practices)
- [ ] Provenance documented
- [ ] Content is accurate and helpful
- [ ] No offensive or inappropriate content
- [ ] Appropriate difficulty level
- [ ] Tags from approved taxonomy

## 15.3 Batch Review Process

1. Generate batch of 50-100 items
2. Run automated validation
3. Flag items below quality threshold
4. Human review of flagged items
5. Approve/reject each item
6. Publish approved items
7. Update category counts

# PART 18: DETAILED GENERATION INSTRUCTIONS PER CATEGORY


### Yogic Practices

Generate practices with clear instructions, session steps with timing, safety notes. Each subcategory should have distinct techniques. Vary duration 3-30 min. Include contraindications for physical practices.
